how: Scenario 1, point 3. `visa.open` of a resource that the file does not define fails with `visa.resource_not_found`, code -1073807343, after the timeout of the open, 2 s (libs/visa/simulation.md, section 6). The query skips on the error, `handle e2` takes `_`, so the verdict is `Verdict.Error`; `visa.close`, `always`, passes the error on to `err`. No session is opened.
